title: From Intrinsic Toxicity to Reception-Based Toxicity: A Contextual Framework for Prediction and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing intrinsic text-only toxicity scores from commercial models (OpenAI Moderation API and Google Perspective API) against a novel community reception-based metric (PONOS) on a dataset featuring African-American Vernacular English (AAVE) and slang from r/BlackPeopleTwitter, to demonstrate the over-flagging of benign in-group dialects.

Analyzing the systematic disagreement between context-agnostic toxicity classifiers and collective social reception (measured via the sentiment of community replies) to reveal how culturally situated profanity, humor, and identity-referential language are frequently misclassified as toxic.
